C1306.title: Shengzhou Ms. Li Defrauded of 3.95 Million Yuan in Virtual Currency Pig-Butchering Scam
C1306.summary: Starting in July 2020, Ms. Li from Shengzhou met Yang on WeChat. Through long-term chats Yang built trust, sent a 72mex virtual currency trading platform link and profit screenshots, and induced investment by claiming insider information and a professional team. After small initial profits, Li increased investment to a total of 3.95 million yuan. Yang later disappeared, the platform could not be opened, and the funds were nearly lost. Police later arrested 11 suspects and recovered more than 2.5 million yuan.
